data: Amazon (AMZN) delivered a decisive profitability turnaround in fiscal 2023. Revenue rose to $574.8 billion in fiscal 2023 from $514.0 billion in fiscal 2022, representing growth of 11.8%. More striking was the bottom line, where net income reached $30.4 billion in fiscal 2023 after a net loss of $2.7 billion in fiscal 2022. Cash generation improved sharply, with operating cash flow of $84.9 billion in fiscal 2023 compared with $46.8 billion in fiscal 2022. The balance sheet also strengthened. Cash and cash equivalents climbed to $73.4 billion at fiscal 2023 year-end from $53.9 billion in fiscal 2022, and total assets grew to $527.9 billion from $462.7 billion. Total liabilities rose more modestly, to $326.0 billion in fiscal 2023 from $316.6 billion in fiscal 2022, which suggests asset growth comfortably outpaced new obligations.
